reasons.observation: The acquisition infrastructure captures only TCP port 80 traffic, while v1 defined TCP, UDP, and ICMP protocol-fraction features.
reasons.correction: Scope Dataset B explicitly to controlled-laboratory HTTP/TCP port 80 traffic and remove tcp_fraction, udp_fraction, and icmp_fraction.

reasons.observation: Earlier provenance instrumentation transmitted semantic run/workload metadata in HTTP headers.
reasons.correction: Dataset-B acquisition transmits only class-neutral X-Request-ID UUID instrumentation. Run ID and workload type remain acquisition/client ground-truth metadata and are not transmitted in HTTP.

reasons.observation: v1 assigned one independent validation run and one independent test run per class.
reasons.correction: Increase to two independent validation runs and two independent test runs per class while retaining four training runs per class.
